reason: A settings utility for configuring reasoning-effort levels, default routing, and Anthropic token budgets for third-party models, with changes persisted in the llm-pi-ai settings namespace.

summaries.zh: 在设置页为第三方模型配置思考努力度档位、默认路由档位及适用的 Anthropic token 预算，并同步到模型选择器。
summaries.en: Configure reasoning-effort levels, default routing levels, and applicable Anthropic token budgets for third-party models from the settings page and model picker.

capabilities: Adds a settings-page interface for configuring model reasoning-effort levels
Reads and writes llm-pi-ai user settings
Lists available providers and models through existing host APIs
Refreshes model-picker data after settings or adapter updates
